mode: Read-only static caller and Retrofit annotation recovery; isolated synthetic requests/UI; no phone or authenticated cloud writes.

requestContracts.value: JSON object containing only changed whitelisted preference keys; boolean values serialized as 1/0 strings

facts: Native sync table contains 34 explicit recognized system_config keys; this module allows only the privacy/notification subset.
Native upload builds a JSONObject from the changed-key map and posts the JSON string, rather than replaying the entire loaded config.
Native bool type 0 uses string 1 as true and string 0 as false; type 1 retains string enum values.
The loadConfig key-only overload matches the caller. reSet/refresh/isReset variants are deliberately excluded.

restrictions: Guard enabled disables @, private-message and feed-reply range selectors.
feed_disallow_reply=-1 is a server read-only restriction, not one of the four editable options.
Guard enable generates net_abuse_guard_timestamp=current Unix seconds+604800; callers cannot set it.
Enable/disable guard warnings mention a two-hour re-enable cooldown. No invented client-side cooldown field or override is sent.
Disabling history/recent record and personalized recommendation, and restricting replies, use recovered explicit confirmation messages.

The history/recent confirmation caller sets its preference and sends a refresh event; a separate server clear endpoint is not inferred. Desktop local history recording/clearing must respect the returned values.
The mobile reply-subscription toggle also invokes Android notification-manager permission callbacks. These Android callbacks are not represented as a Windows notification permission success.
Account cloud preferences are editable; Windows background push delivery is not implemented or claimed by this module.

coverage: Native 10 privacy and 10 subscription fields and exact enum values
Whitelisted one-setting patch validation before network; no credentials/reset/arbitrary config replay
Account snapshot checks at each awaited request boundary; active main account scope adds epoch guard
Reads current restrictions before writing; reads changed field and guard timestamp back before reporting success
Idempotent existing explicit value skips POST, including verification resume after a completed save
Failed writes retain observed state and immutable intended patch; uncertain submissions expose reload without automatic retry
Guest login, loading, manual reload, safe verification, confirmations, cancellation and narrow keyboard controls
Unmount/account/page changes invalidate held writes and pending verification retries
